title: Charges API no longer accepts the source parameter

source.quote: (illustrative) Starting 2027-03-01, POST /v1/charges rejects the source parameter on every API version. Use PaymentIntents with a payment_method instead.

title: gpt-4o is retired from the API

source.quote: (illustrative) On 2027-01-15, gpt-4o will be shut down. Requests that name it will fail; migrate to a current model.

title: REST Admin API product endpoints are removed in favour of GraphQL

source.quote: (illustrative) The REST Admin API /products endpoints are removed on 2027-04-01. Use the GraphQL Admin API products query and productSet mutation.

title: Conversations onMessageAdded webhooks drop the legacy Media field

source.quote: (illustrative) From 2027-02-01, Conversations onMessageAdded webhooks no longer include the legacy Media field. Read media from the Media resource instead.
